newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures steady ahead of Jospin speech.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures steady ahead of Jospin speech.

text.p: 0930 GMT - Sept bond future steady after BTAN auction, German Ifo survey. Stuck in narrow range ahead of government policy speech due 1300 GMT, seen capped at 129.00 for now. As expected 5-year BTANs saw best demand, overall cover for auction 2.8. No rate change expected after BoF council meeting. Sept PIBOR lower, franc slightly weaker vs mark at 3.3740.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield unch 5.60 pct. Bund spread -11 vs -12
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR 96.53, off 2 bp
